name: Compression
label: zip / gzip / tar / tgz
description: Compress or decompress a platform file ref (zip, gzip, tar, tgz). Zip-slip rejected. Ports and file params use type file.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Compression operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'compress'.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Source archive or payload. Required type file: absolute sandbox path under /sandbox/files, ContentBlock (data/base64), or $fileRef — not a bare ref-id string. Example: /sandbox/files/input.txt.

schema.label: file_name
schema.description: Output filename (single segment, no / or ..). Omitted → default from source name + format.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: compress | decompress. Required. Example: 'compress'.

configurationParameters.label: Format
configurationParameters.description: zip | gzip | tar | tgz. Default zip.

configurationParameters.label: File Name
configurationParameters.description: Output archive/file name (not a file ref). Example: 'bundle.zip'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
